# Correct Spelling

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Corrects the spelling of a word or sentence. Words can be placed in an array.

## Syntax

~~~~text
correctSpelling(text: <#arrayorstring#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
correctSpelling(text: Hello World!)
~~~~
